requirements.text: Each debounced press steps COUNT up or down by one or clears it, wrapping modulo 65536
A button change shorter than the debounce time never makes a press
LED brightness is linear in the effective duty over one PWM period
The display lights exactly one digit at a time, in order, showing COUNT and the duty in hex
The register window has the listed map and reset values
The design closes timing at 100 MHz with no unconstrained path
The design stays within its predicted resources and uses no BRAM or DSP
On the board the register window answers as the model predicts
A shell write to COUNT on the same clock as a press wins over the press
Releasing a button never makes a press
On the board the ILA captures of the count write and the PWM agree with the model
